title: Committed kW — Minimum Commitments and Change Windows in the Demand Response Programs
content:
In the Demand Response Programs, the committed kW is the load reduction, battery discharge or firm-service-level reduction that an enrollment commits to deliver. Each program sets the smallest commitment it accepts and the window in which a commitment may be changed; a minimum of 0 kW means that the program takes no commitment.

| Program | Smallest commitment accepted | When and how the committed kW may be changed |
|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | 0 kW (no commitment) | Not applicable |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | 0 kW (no commitment) | Not applicable |
| AC Cycling Program | 0 kW (no commitment) | Not applicable |
| Home Battery Dispatch | 3.0 kW of discharge | Committed kW may be changed once before each season |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | 10.0 kW of load reduction | The nomination for the next month may be changed by the fifth business day of the current month |
| Base Interruptible Program | 100.0 kW of firm-service-level reduction | The firm service level may be changed once a year, in November, for the next program year |

## Notes for the business and battery programs

- **Home Battery Dispatch** — the commitment is a discharge commitment of at least 3.0 kW. It may be changed once before each event season.
- **Commercial Capacity Bidding Program** — the commitment is a monthly nomination of at least 10.0 kW. A change to next month's nomination is accepted up to and including the fifth business day of the current month.
- **Base Interruptible Program** — the commitment is a reduction to a firm service level, of at least 100.0 kW. The firm service level is changed only in November, once a year, and the change applies to the next program year.

## Illustrations (hypothetical commitments)

| Hypothetical commitment stated | Program | At or above the smallest commitment? |
|---|---|---|
| 3.0 kW | Home Battery Dispatch | Yes — equal to the minimum |
| 2.5 kW | Home Battery Dispatch | No |
| 10.0 kW | Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | Yes — equal to the minimum |
| 9.5 kW | Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | No |
| 100.0 kW | Base Interruptible Program | Yes — equal to the minimum |
| 95.0 kW | Base Interruptible Program | No |
